# base64

Encode and decode Base64 data through MoonX.

## Usage

```sh
moonx cli/base64 input.txt

moonx cli/base64 --decode encoded.txt > decoded.txt

printf 'hello' | moonx cli/base64 -w 0
```

Read one file or stdin and write stdout. Encoding wraps at 76 characters by default; -w 0 also removes the trailing newline.

## Common options

<!-- BEGIN GENERATED OPTIONS -->
<!-- Generated by tools/metadata from options.json. -->

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `-d`, `--decode` | Decode input; embedded newlines are accepted. |
| `-i`, `--ignore-garbage` | Discard non-alphabet bytes while decoding. |
| `-w VALUE`, `--wrap VALUE` | Set output width; 0 disables wrapping and the final newline. Default: `76`. |
| `--help` | Show help. |
| `--version` | Show the version. |
| `-D` | Decode input; embedded newlines are accepted. |
<!-- END GENERATED OPTIONS -->

## Notes

- Decoding streams input and may emit a valid prefix before reporting invalid data. Ignoring garbage does not make invalid padding valid.
- -D is a project alias for --decode.

See the [compatibility guide](../../docs/compatibility.md) for the supported profile.
